purpose: reduce the attack surface of the networks, hosts and cloud configuration the system runs on
entry_criteria: Security baseline or benchmark is chosen
Access to configuration data is available
procedure: Check network exposure: which ports and services are reachable from the internet and between zones.
Assess cloud and host configuration against the chosen baseline (for example CIS) and record gaps.
Review identity and access: roles, wildcard permissions, unused credentials, and administrative paths.
Check encryption in transit and at rest, logging and patch status.
Rate findings, fix through infrastructure as code, and rescan.
Record accepted risks with owner and expiry.
acceptance_criteria: No unintended service is exposed to the internet
No wildcard administrative permission without an exception
Encryption and logging are enabled where required

validation.command: ss -tlnp   # example; list listening ports on a host you own and compare with the approved list
trivy config terraform/   # example baseline check
validation.expect: no high findings outside the exception register

failure_modes.response: Remove public access and review data exposure

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A review finds a database port reachable from the internet and an administrative role with a wildcard permission. Both are fixed in infrastructure code and the rescan shows them closed.
